```{r}
library(carData)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```


```{r}
Rossi
```

```{r}
survfit(Surv(week, arrest) ~ 1, data=Rossi) %>% 
    ggsurvfit() 
```

```{r}
sf = survfit(Surv(week, arrest) ~ fin, data = Rossi)
ggsurvplot(sf, data=Rossi)
```



```{r}
mod = coxph(Surv(week, arrest) ~fin, data=Rossi)
ggsurvplot(
  survfit(
    mod,
    newdata = tibble(fin=c('yes','no')),
    data=Rossi),
  legend.labs = c("Financial Aid", "No Financial Aid"))
```

```{r}
summary(mod)
```



```{r}
mod_2 = coxph(Surv(week, arrest)~ age + fin, data=Rossi)
anova(mod, mod_2)
```



```{r}
colnames(Rossi)
```
```{r}
mod_all = coxph(Surv(week, arrest)~ age + fin + race + wexp + mar + paro + prio + educ, data=Rossi)
summary(mod_all)
```
